debug_cache.description: Emit additional cache consistency diagnostics while evaluating samples.

orientation_pat.description: Optional orientation pattern restricting which causal-flow orientations are evaluated.

store_additional_weights_in_event.description: Persist every configured additional weight on each generated event.

enabled_dampening.description: Apply the damping profile; disabling it leaves the corresponding factor equal to one.

function.description: Functional form of the counterterm damping profile.

power.description: Optional polynomial power overriding the profile's built-in choice.

sigma.description: Characteristic width of the damping profile.

Helicity.description: Helicity input. Use -1, 0, or 1 for fixed helicities; or use a string for summed modes.

oneOf.description: Integrate over the full radial domain and regulate it with an H-function profile.

h_function_settings.description: Damping profile used to make the infinite-domain counterterm integral convergent.

oneOf.description: Integrate over the compact radial domain without an infinite-tail damping profile.

range.description: Integration domain and damping function used for integrated counterterms.

bin_number_evolution.description: Optional per-iteration bin counts, overriding the fixed `n_bins` value as training proceeds.

continuous_dim_learning_rate.description: Update rate for adaptive grids over continuous integration dimensions.

discrete_dim_learning_rate.description: Update rate for learned probabilities over discrete sampling choices.

integrated_phase.description: Complex component to integrate: real, imaginary, or both.

max_prob_ratio.description: Cap the ratio used when turning sampled weights into adaptive probabilities.

min_samples_for_update.description: Minimum accumulated samples before an adaptive grid or discrete probability is updated.

n_bins.description: Number of bins maintained along each continuous integration dimension.

n_increase.description: Samples added to each successive Monte Carlo iteration.

n_max.description: Hard upper bound on the total number of integrand evaluations.

n_start.description: Number of samples in the first Monte Carlo iteration.

observables_output.description: File formats used when writing observable histograms and distributions.

seed.description: Seed for deterministic initialization of Monte Carlo random-number streams.

show_max_wgt_info.description: Include maximum-weight diagnostics in integration progress and result data.

target_absolute_accuracy.description: Stop once the estimated absolute uncertainty reaches this value, if configured.

target_relative_accuracy.description: Stop once the estimated relative uncertainty reaches this value, if configured.

train_on_avg.description: Train adaptive distributions on iteration averages instead of individual sample weights.

e_cm.description: Center-of-mass energy used to normalize and construct external momenta.

externals.description: External momentum and helicity configuration evaluated by the integrand.

uv_localisation.description: Widths and override controls for ultraviolet-counterterm localization dampers.

format.description: Output formats written for configured observables; duplicates and `none` are ignored.

pat.description: Symbolica pattern matched against serialized causal orientations.

oneOf.description: Maximize the smallest unnormalized energy depth, as in the original solver.
Maximize a conservative Euclidean ball radius using the active routing norms.

Minimize the signed sum of E-surface values while preserving the best certified
relaxed-Chebyshev clearance within solver accuracy.

check_global_center.description: Validate that the selected global center lies inside every required E-surface.

enable_heuristics.description:
Enable the configured heuristic center tests before invoking the overlap solver.
An explicitly forced center is independent of this switch and is always validated.

force_global_center.description: Explicit three-vector center used for every threshold overlap, when provided.

objective.description:
Refine final maximal-overlap centers after enabled heuristics fail their interior checks.
Optional objectives leave catalogue membership unchanged and retain a certified witness
if their fixed iteration budget or physical validation rejects an optimization result.

try_origin.description: Try the loop-momentum origin as the global center before solving for another point.

try_origin_all_lmbs.description: Try the origin independently for every available loop-momentum basis.

ParseableAtom.description: An atom that is serialized as a string. Do not make any assumptions about the state

large_deformation_check.description: Maximum dimensionless deformation before the improved point is rejected.

mode.description: On-shell improvement algorithm, or `none` to preserve the supplied momenta.

only_warn_on_large_deformation.description: Warn instead of failing when an improvement exceeds the deformation threshold.

computation.description: Quantity computation mode: scalar projection per object, exact object count, or pairwise quantity.

order.description: Sorting direction applied together with ordering.

ordering.description: Ordering key used before entry_selection. Particle scalar quantities default to Quantity, jet scalar quantities default to PT, and pair quantities default to Quantity.

quantity.description: Per-object scalar quantity used when computation = "scalar".

clustered_pdgs.description: Optional list of PDG IDs allowed to be clustered. Use null to derive the default from the model, or a compact list like [-1,1,21,82] in CLI key-value assignments.

computation.description: Quantity computation mode: scalar projection per object, exact object count, or pairwise quantity.

order.description: Sorting direction applied together with ordering.

ordering.description: Ordering key used before entry_selection. Particle scalar quantities default to Quantity, jet scalar quantities default to PT, and pair quantities default to Quantity.

quantity.description: Per-object scalar quantity used when computation = "scalar".

SamplingChannelDefinition.description:
A graph-scoped channel definition.  `parent_lmb` is deliberately explicit:
resolving a short expression against a graph is a later validation step,
while exported definitions must never lose the routing frame they use.

channel_weight.description:
Override the global channel score for this named channel. OSE scores
require a complete ordinary LMB map; advanced maps keep their actual
density unless an explicit compatible proxy is selected.

singularity_proxy.description:
Optional positive singularity proxy used when the effective global or
per-channel weight is `singularity_proxy`. The expression is
parsed by Symbolica and evaluated in the complete master raw frame;
its variables are `x0`, `x1`, ... in coordinate order.  A proxy is
never inferred from the map, since doing so could hide an incomplete
singularity model.

subspace_lmb.description:
Ordered loop edges spanning the coordinates in which a surface or
joint constraint is solved.  This is distinct from the edge set in
`around`, which identifies the physical energy constraints.

SamplingChannelWeight.description:
Weighting strategy for the resolved sampling-channel partition.

Exact inverse-map densities, on-shell-energy scores, and explicit positive
proxies share the same channel catalogue. `inverse_jacobian` selects the
same density score as `map_density`; `ose` is a distinct energy score.

SamplingRadialProfile.description:
A normalized proposal for the auxiliary LU scale. This changes sampling
only: the physical LU h-function and its raised-cut derivatives are intact.

SamplingRadialProfileKind.description: Radial proposal family for a physical-cut sampling channel.

alpha.description: Exponent of each selected loop edge's on-shell energy in an OSE channel score.

b.description: Scale parameter of the selected radial mapping.

channel_definitions.description: Named channel definitions keyed first by graph name, then by channel name.

channel_selection.description: Channel selectors keyed by graph name, overriding the default selection.

coordinate_system.description: Coordinate system used to parameterize loop momenta.

default_channel_selection.description: Default channel selectors for graphs without a graph-specific selection.

graph_names.description: Optional graph-name allow-list for discrete graph sampling.

graphs.description: Whether graph contributions are summed deterministically or sampled as a discrete axis.

lmb_basis_ids.description: Explicit loop-momentum-basis identifiers keyed by graph name.

mapping.description: Mapping from the unit hypercube to unbounded radial coordinates.

orientations.description: Whether causal orientations are summed deterministically or sampled as a discrete axis.

power.description: Power parameter of the selected radial mapping.

sampling_channel_weight.description: Rule used to construct the relative probability of each resolved sampling channel.

sampling_channels.description: Whether resolved sampling channels are summed or sampled discretely.

sampling_multichanneling.description: Enable multichannel sampling over the resolved graph-aware channels.

three_dimensional_representation.description: Representation for this attempt; omission selects the first generated representation.

ecm_relative_tolerance_for_im.description:
Independent dimensionless imaginary-component tolerance, with the same
E_cm-relative convention as `ecm_relative_tolerance_for_re`.

ecm_relative_tolerance_for_re.description:
Dimensionless real-component probe disagreement relative to E_cm raised
to the observable's declared energy dimension, with its output-unit
conversion. Includes every sample factor and the outer grid weight;
direct momentum densities account for the missing spatial measure.
Zero disables this alternative to relative accuracy. This is not the
integrator's target standard error.

escalate_for_large_weight_threshold.description: Ratio threshold for the large-weight escalation check; a non-positive value disables it.

precision.description: Numeric precision used for this escalation level.

required_precision_for_im.description: Maximum accepted relative error in the imaginary component before escalating.

required_precision_for_re.description: Maximum accepted relative error in the real component before escalating.

record_all_stability_levels.description: Record the result produced at every attempted numerical-precision level.

record_loop_momenta_escalation.description: Record evaluations escalated because of the loop-momentum norm threshold.

record_rotated_results.description: Record the values obtained at rotated phase-space points.

check_on_norm.description: Compare rotated results after normalizing by the result magnitude.

escalate_if_exact_zero.description: Escalate precision when a result is exactly zero at the current level.

integrated_energy_dimension.description:
Energy dimension of the integrated physical quantity after flux
normalization and before conversion to output units. Required when an
E_cm-relative tolerance is enabled for a physical evaluation; reference
functions carry their own known dimensions. Direct momentum evaluations
subtract the dimension of their missing spatial integration measure.

levels.description: Ordered precision and representation choices with tolerances for stability escalation.

loop_momenta_norm_escalation_factor.description: Escalate when the loop-momentum norm exceeds this factor; a negative value disables it.

min_abs_wgt_for_escalation.description:
Suppress non-final stability escalation for negligible weighted probes.
When positive, a probe is allowed to remain at its current precision if
its largest absolute weighted rotation result is below this fraction of
an absolute-component integral estimate whose relative standard error
is at most ten percent. Zero disables this waiver.

recording.description: Optional diagnostics retained for rotated, escalated, and high-precision evaluations.

rotation_axis.description: Rotations applied when comparing an unstable sample with an equivalent phase-space point.

disable_threshold_subtraction.description: Disable local threshold subtraction while leaving the original integrand unchanged.

esurface_existence_threshold.description:
Dimensionless tolerance used to compare the energy-squared E-surface invariant margin
against `esurface_existence_threshold * E_cm^2` at runtime.

integrated_ct_settings.description: Configuration for analytically integrated counterterm contributions.

local_ct_settings.description: Configuration for local ultraviolet counterterms in the numerical integrand.

overlap_settings.description: Strategy used to choose centers shared by overlapping threshold surfaces.

radial_root_residual_tolerance.description:
Multiplier of `epsilon(T) * E_cm` used as the direct residual limit for
threshold-counterterm radial roots at numerical precision `T`. A residual-limited
higher-precision root may instead be accepted against the corresponding lower-precision
limit after satisfying the cross-precision consistency checks.

dynamic_width.description: Derive the localization width dynamically from the sampled ultraviolet configuration.

force_uv_dampers_to_one.description: Replace ultraviolet localization dampers by one for diagnostic comparisons.

gaussian_width.description: Width of the Gaussian ultraviolet localization factor.

sliver_width.description: Width of the transition region used by the ultraviolet sliver damper.

smooth_sliver.description: Make the compact sliver profile smooth at its support boundary.
